mapper.sql: id, username, password, real_name, email, mobile, avatar, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND password = #{password} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.email, u.mobile, u.avatar, u.status, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.deleted, r.id as role_id, r.role_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, real_name, email, mobile, avatar, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{email}, #{mobile}, #{avatar}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET username = #{username}, real_name = #{realName}, email = #{email}, mobile = #{mobile}, avatar = #{avatar}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.delete: UPDATE sys_user SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
